trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — no multiplayer, no DLC, no extra step. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the stranger strands and the last clean-up trophies. A Long Road is the last gate for most hunters; once it pops, this one follows at once.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it pops at the mission's end. You cannot miss it and there is nothing to prepare — just play the first mission through. It is the first of the twelve story trophies.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 1 — the trophy pops as the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Keep a save at the end of Chapter 1 if you like a safety net, but nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 2; it pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Story-only, no side work needed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Chapter 4; it pops when you finish the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. Nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the final story mission and the trophy pops with the ending. After it, free-roam opens and the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats — that is where the real clean-up begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops during the mission, part of the story, and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story-only, nothing else to do.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. Story-only.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Story-only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, the airport mission that also teaches you the VCIA layout you will reuse for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic. Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Story-only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which unlocks under Progress > Stats after the story. It is far kinder than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need 70 of the 80 Challenges. The strict lines are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 15 of the 18 Meditation Spots. Everything counts from the start of the game, and nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them however you like — under the bridges is the quickest. Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find them on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need to try each one — no win or high score required — and most of them come up naturally in the story. Check your progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities; the last type you are missing is the one to go and do.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. Find the ranges on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero are the two named ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some are locked until you meet their conditions. You need every gold for the 100% checklist too, so this is not optional.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find them on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones; some charge an entry fee. Win once at each location and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations around Leonida — track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. You have to win 20 different ones; winning the same race twice does not count. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's rating can be improved with mod shop upgrades.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot — catch a Parrotfish over 2kg in the marked area. You need a boat with a fishing rod; hijack one nearby if you do not own one. Follow Cal's fishing questline and the trophy pops when you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish all the levels of one of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once, on any game; beating the extra challenges is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the end. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams, and he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving for 7 shipwrecks — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2-3 (call Brian as Jason to speed it up), so nothing is missable. The trophy pops after his final mission, Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — confirmed ones are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being confirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Track your count in the trophy list, and do the strands after the story if you like — they are all still there.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) — scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if they are on the list, then drive them back in good condition for a better payout. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Go to the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City and destroy them (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest), then Tyrone gives you the Spin On This quest to shut the labs down. Finish it and the trophy pops. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations — and do the Chapter 1 one while you still can. This is the only missable trophy in the game: one morning in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her, accept the optional quest and meditate with her. That meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked — it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, so do it and remove the risk. The other 18 spots stay available in free roam; meditate at each with both Jason and Lucia (each spot counts double that way), and track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18, so you can relax after this one — but do the Chapter 1 meditation first.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you — meet him in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted. He then marks hunting spots and asks for specific animals; bring them back to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest. PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal exactly triggers the trophy, but clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks — which the 100% checklist needs anyway — should cover it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game — collect every card in any 3 of them. Track your sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress, and the 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to open it, then hold R1 on a spot). Anything counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Track your count under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. View them under Progress > Challenges — each one shows its requirement and a completed checkmark. Most come naturally while you work on everything else, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way. Save it for late, then pick the easiest challenges you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner along and escape the heat. This is possible once Jason and Lucia can roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle through traffic works, or drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters lose you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone. You will also get it automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. This is possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased, keeping the red-and-blue flashing wanted level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The unlock is delayed — it pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so if it does not appear, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and you discover one by getting inside it or by scanning it with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time and highlights weak spots, and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, then line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. Focus has 4 levels — raise it with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets easier as you level up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it has to be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, go up the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it introduces bank vault robberies and you do the first one in the mission: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to open the vault, then rob it with your partner (hand off a bag with hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips — he marks the vans with purple icons. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way — and each bank pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius — a Pay 'n' Spray helps.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. It counts the moment the last patch of fog lifts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them (many are also marked automatically from story progress). One per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method for this one is not confirmed at launch — no guide has verified the exact trigger yet. Watch for an update after launch; the description points to a cocktail spot on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The method for this one is not confirmed at launch — no guide has verified the exact trigger yet. Watch for an update after launch.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the north-east table, and blow open the safe in the north-east hallway with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a while — go back and take what is left, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your strength under Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, and always go together with your partner (call them with hold Right + Triangle) so both make progress at once. You can also work out at home after the story. PowerPyx gives this method, but it is still unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a little demon face appears whenever something counts. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — Irredeemable is permanent, so do not go overboard. It comes naturally while you work on everything else; if it is the last trophy left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Track your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The method for this one is not confirmed at launch — PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Watch for an update after launch.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The method for this one is not confirmed at launch — PowerPyx believes it is from a UFO questline. Watch for an update after launch; past GTA games hid their UFOs at odd hours in remote spots.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The method for this one is not confirmed at launch — the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. Watch for an update after launch.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 adds up across robberies; you do not need to bring it all at once. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while you do the robberies for 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest because they are the most expensive. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. It adds up across the whole game, so just keep buying what you need.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them all through the app. The 8 garages cost $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000 and Store n' Bolt $16,800. The 4 story garages do not count. Each garage adds a parking spot you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes — each garage adds parking spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage, or register at any Pay 'n' Spray. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
